name: Alex Verastegui
bio: He is a versatile professional who has journeyed from Peru to New York and Jacksonville, embodying adaptability. His career in sales and account development is driven by a passion for helping others succeed. He excels at attentive listening, ensuring his solutions precisely match client needs. Committed to transparency and client experience, he believes in collaborative success and giving his absolute best in every interaction.

name: Delonda Allen
bio: She is a North Florida Real Estate Agent who brings a strategic, yet personable approach to the home-buying and home-selling process. Drawing from years of experience as a public servant in the educational and government sector, Delonda is refreshingly friendly and exerts customer care with the ability to guide buyers to obtain the best value for their dream home and to assist sellers to a smooth, stress-free sale of their home. Delonda has knowledge of the different cities and neighborhoods across the North Florida area. She serves this area and commits herself to home buying and selling, and investment properties. Delonda obtained a Master's Degree in Public Administration and a Master's Degree in Business Administration from Grand Canyon University. Now she brings her commitment to legendary quality service, passion, and sharp attention to detail to help buyers in a highly focused search for their new house and to help sellers get the most value for their home. Delonda understands that buying and selling is one of the biggest decisions in a client's life and views the representation and guidance of her clients through this process as a true privilege.

name: Johann Velez
bio: He is a dedicated and experienced real estate agent who brings a wealth of expertise in sales and customer service to his clients. With a passion for helping individuals and families find their perfect homes, Johann is known for his personable approach, strong negotiation skills, and deep understanding of the market.   Clients who work with Johann can expect exceptional professionalism, clear and honest communication, and a tailored experience that meets their unique needs. He takes pride in guiding clients through every step of the process, ensuring a smooth and stress-free journey toward achieving their real estate goals.   Beyond his professional accomplishments, Johann is a devoted family man who cherishes spending quality time with loved ones. When he's not assisting clients, you can find him enjoying his favorite pastimes, playing golf, baseball, or cheering on his favorite teams.   With a commitment to excellence and a heart for connecting people with their dream properties, Johann Velez is your trusted partner in real estate.

name: Julio Arango
bio: I understand life's daily challenges, and I believe buying or selling your home shouldn't be one of them. My focus is on your needs and goals, building lasting relationships. Leveraging my 20+ years of military experience and MRP accreditation, I expertly guide clients, especially military families. As the Spanish translator for the Agents of Shields team, I ensure clear communication. I'm passionate about exceptional customer service, helping with first homes, relocations, or retirement properties. My priority is making your real estate journey smooth and successful.

name: Lekeshia Jones
bio: An experienced professional property manager/regional manager with over 18 years of service. I have managed single-family homes, apartments, and townhomes, along with overseeing multiple maintenance staff. Some of the biggest achievements were the ability to keep resident retention low and the award for property manager of the year in the state of Alabama. In 2021, I decided to advance my career more by working with a real estate company as a professional property coordinator. I then enrolled in the Career Academy of Real Estate school in 2023 and became a certified professional NAR member in 2024. Real estate is more than a career to me; I have a passion for helping others.

name: Margie Olsen-Alvarez
bio: As a former Transportation and Logistics professional, Margie transitioned to Real Estate, applying her customer service and compliance skills. Her experience allows her to focus on clients’ needs while ensuring ethical and compliant transactions. As a long-time NE Florida resident and Navy wife, she offers local market expertise and understands military relocation challenges. Margie coordinates transaction milestones, document flow, and communication between agents, buyers, sellers, and lenders throughout the closing process.

name: Molly Plude
bio: Molly Plude was born in Cambodia before moving to Jacksonville when she was twelve. Growing up with a businessman for a father, she learned valuable skills that led her to a career in real estate. Having experienced the buying and selling process herself, she understands how crucial it is to have a knowledgeable Real Estate Agent by your side. She’s passionate about helping people find their "forever home," and commits to serving her clients with integrity, transparency, trust, and professionalism.

name: Regiena Brown
bio: She was born and raised in Tifton, GA, and is proud to be a Tift County Athletic Hall of Fame inductee. As a student-athlete at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, her basketball team advanced to the Sweet Sixteen. She holds a BS, an MBA, and an Ed. degree and have extensive experience in Sales and Marketing, including leadership roles with Fortune 500 companies. Now, as a Real Estate Agent and published author, she is dedicated to providing exceptional service with integrity and care. In her free time, she enjoys writing, reading, working out, and spending time with loved ones.

name: Rodrigo Tello Sanchez
bio: Connect with Rodrigo about buying or selling a home and discuss the guidance your next move needs.

name: Sarah Brockner
bio: She has a compassionate personality that allows her to easily connect with clients, making the buying/selling process a more stress-free experience. Her ability to listen attentively, to understand clients’ unique needs, and to work tirelessly toward customer satisfaction has placed Sarah as one of the top sales agents on the RCRE team.

name: Taquilla Allen
bio: As a top-producing agent, she brings dedication, discipline, and exceptional service. She proven track record that ensures precise market navigation, seamless experiences, and results exceeding expectations. A former University of Alabama basketball player (B.A. Criminal Justice) and international pro, she later earned a Master's in Criminal Justice and served as a police officer. This background instills service, integrity, and responsibility. Her passion is helping you navigate real estate with exceptional service, achieve outstanding results.

name: Urban Garrett
bio: He is originally from Talladega, Alabama, and has spent the past 22 years working across multiple states in service-oriented roles. He holds a Bachelor of Science, a Master of Public Administration, and a Juris Doctor degree.   With experience in both insurance and real estate sales, he understand that buying or selling a home is a significant milestone. He is committed to ensuring each client enjoys a seamless and rewarding experience. His strong communication and negotiation skills enable me to effectively advocate for his clients’ interests while meeting their unique needs.   Recognized for professionalism, approachability, expertise, and skill, I bring over 20 years of customer service experience to every interaction. He remain dedicated to delivering exceptional results and building lasting relationships with those I serve.

name: Vito Lombardo
bio: When selling your Ponte Vedra home, expert guidance is crucial for maximizing value. Downsizing requires balancing comfort, entertainment, privacy, and financial freedom. Real estate transactions are significant life events, often accompanied by fears and anxieties. Navigating challenges requires a knowledgeable, caring professional. A strategic plan is essential to avoid frustration and disappointment. Working with an experienced agent ensures you don't leave money on the table, providing support throughout the process to achieve the best possible outcome for your unique situation.
